questions: Should the function handle duplicate elements within a sub-list? If duplicates exist, what should the Series index be (e.g., duplicate labels allowed, or raise an error)?
What should happen if a sub-list is empty? Should the function produce an empty Series, skip it, or raise an error?
Are the elements of the sub-lists guaranteed to be hashable and suitable as pandas index labels (e.g., strings, numbers, tuples)?
Is the order of the Series in the output list required to match the order of sub-lists in the input?
Should the function ensure that the shuffled integers are a permutation of 1..N, or could they be any random selection of unique integers in that range (e.g., sampling without replacement)?
What is the expected data type of the Series values? Should they be Python ints, numpy ints, or any numeric type?
If a sub-list contains None, should it be treated as a valid index label?
Should the function modify the input list_of_lists in any way (e.g., shuffling the sub-lists themselves)?
